sections.text: This is a fictional educational illustration only and not a medical assessment. Relevant spaceflight hazards include altered gravity, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, radiation and closed environments. Vital signs give general information about basic body functions when noted with context and time, and a change from personal baseline is a prompt for review rather than a diagnosis. Pulse oximeter readings have limits and are viewed alongside symptoms and observation quality. Stress related outputs do not establish mental health status and sleep duration alone does not describe sleep stage. Any concerning symptoms or marked changes warrant prompt crew medical review.

Model outputs shown here are heuristic and experimental without established accuracy or clinical validation, do not measure radiation dose, immune function or bone density, and future values reflect extrapolation for education only.
